# Treat an empty native key-import result as a semantic failure

importToFFI checks the JSON key inventory even when the native import returned zero. Missing or empty info.keys changes the return to -1. Higher callers also inspect importedKeys.length. In this key-import scope, success needs useful imported material as well as a native success status; this does not mean every application API treats empty results as failure. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/extensions/openpgp.
